name: io.github.jweezy119/Pabandi
title: PabandiOS
description: Trust OS for service businesses — x402 MCP tools, Solana escrow, AI scoring

tools.name: pabandi_verify_passport
tools.description: Verify a Pabandi PTP attestation. Input a base64-encoded attestation and optionally require a capability. Returns valid, granted capabilities, risk band, expiry.

tools.name: pabandi_discover
tools.description: Return the Pabandi Trust Protocol discovery document.

tools.name: pabandi_get_ledger
tools.description: Public audit lookup of a passport issuance charge by idempotency key.

tools.name: pabandi_issue_passport
tools.description: Issue a scoped Agent Capability Passport. Metered at 1.0 USDC per issue via x402.

tools.name: pabandi_verify_property
tools.description: Verify property documents and landlord/tenant trust scores against PLRA and SBCA databases.

tools.name: pabandi_initiate_escrow
tools.description: Initiate a Solana escrow for conditional payment. Requires x402 payment of 0.5 USDC.

tools.name: pabandi_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking with AI trust scoring and escrow protection. Requires AP2 mandates (intent, cart, payment) and x402 payment of 0.25 USDC.
